segments.text: What if getting help was only one tap away?
and there's no time to waste.
Meet ThreatTrack, connecting citizens, dispatchers, and police in one real-time response system.
Facing an emergency? Hold SOS for three seconds. Your exact location is sent straight to the nearest station.
Not an emergency? Three simple taps. Choose the incident, snap a photo, and send your report.
No more wondering what happens next. Track your report and follow every update in real time.
Behind the scenes, dispatchers see incoming reports automatically prioritized by urgency.
With one click, AI checks the report. Headquarters assigns the response. The nearest unit gets moving, and you stay informed.
Live hotspot maps reveal where incidents are happening, helping authorities see patterns before they escalate.
AI even prepares response plans based on real protocols. But the final decision? Always human.
Your barangay, your local station, Valenzuela Police. One connected system, greater transparency, protected privacy, a safer community.
Every report matters. Every response counts.
